eyebrow: The same three-part shape, every time

steps.label: 1. State preparation
steps.sub: Hadamard every qubit -- equal superposition over all 2^n candidate bitstrings

steps.label: 2. p alternating layers
steps.sub: Cost unitary U_C(gamma), then mixer unitary U_B(beta), repeated p times

steps.label: 3. Measurement
steps.sub: Measure repeatedly, keep the best bitstring seen -- depth p means exactly 2p parameters

code:
gamma = pi/2, beta = pi/8:
  |00> 0.0000   |01> 0.5000
  |10> 0.5000   |11> 0.0000
  expected cost = 1.0  (the true max)

gamma = 0.1, beta = 0.1:
  expected cost = ~0.519 (worse than a coin flip)
caption: Same circuit, same problem, wildly different quality -- two numbers, gamma and beta, are the entire difference.

eyebrow: Why "variational" if the structure is fixed?

steps.label: Fixed structure
steps.sub: Hadamards, then p rounds of cost/mixer unitaries -- decided in advance

steps.label: Tunable numbers
steps.sub: The 2p parameters inside it are adjusted by a classical optimizer outside

steps.label: The hybrid loop
steps.sub: Quantum evaluates a candidate; classical proposes the next one -- shared with VQE
